run_demo_position_control: run the trifinger simulation demo with position control mode and random joint targets
run_demo_torque_control: run the trifinger simulation demo with torque control mode and random joint torques
create_simfinger_instance: create a SimFinger instance with a specified finger type and visualization enabled
test_finger_action_position: test creating a finger Action with desired joint positions for position control
test_finger_action_torque: test creating a finger Action with desired joint torques for torque control
